notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: Implemented the persisted optional counting semaphore across the shared ControlService used by HTTP and MCP. The dashboard can enable a limit from 1 to 64 and shows usage and holders; service status and the MCP get_server_capacity tool expose the same state. Starts acquire atomically, switches retain their slot, failures release it, and lowering the limit preserves running servers. Focused tests cover contention for the final slot, capacity exhaustion, switch retention, failed-start release, persistence, HTTP, MCP, and localization. Keep the item open until the rebuilt controller is explicitly installed and exercised with real managed processes; the active service was not restarted implicitly.

notes.text: Joint analysis and exact test matrix are in NOTE-20260908-multi-project-verification-plan/analysis-and-plan.md. Source inspection found capacityStatusCompact drops failed runtimes whose PID/ownership is retained, while full capacity still counts them; reproduce and correct this shared status discrepancy first. Refine historical acceptance: a failed start releases capacity only after confirmed owned cleanup, and an MCP claim can remain held when its runtime start is denied. Compare full, compact and operation-result capacity at stable barriers. No runtime reproduction or application tests were run for this plan; keep the item open until isolated real-process acceptance passes.

problem: The optional capacity limit is implemented and unit-tested. Remaining work is integrated validation with real managed processes, especially truthful slot accounting after launcher/descendant failures.

risk.rollback: If integrated validation fails, record the failing scenario and leave the installed capacity policy unchanged. Revert only the associated faulty code change; disabling the owner's configured resource gate requires its own authorization.

scope: Exercise the existing semaphore through HTTP and MCP after owned-process cleanup is fixed. Keep reservations independent of capacity and preserve slots during switches.
Record isolated runtime evidence and close this item only when its existing contention/failure acceptance checks pass. Do not reimplement the semaphore or add production mode here.

Use NOTE-20260908-multi-project-verification-plan for shared real-controller fixtures and controlled cleanup regressions. Resolve confirmed compact/full capacity disagreement without adding a second capacity counter or hydrating rich snapshots for routine compact reads.
title: Validate the implemented server capacity with owned process cleanup
validation: With capacity two, start two projects and verify a third HTTP start or MCP claim/start cannot spawn a process. Report any retained agent claim separately from the runtime capacity rejection.
Verify two simultaneous requests for the last slot cannot both start, including requests arriving through HTTP and MCP.

Verify switching a running project retains its slot. A failed start releases that slot exactly once only after owned cleanup is confirmed; unconfirmed cleanup continues to occupy capacity and blocks a competing start.
Verify lowering capacity never terminates current processes and status consistently identifies every slot holder.

At stable barriers, full capacity, compact project status and runtime-operation results agree after unconfirmed cleanup and after successful recovery; persisted capacity settings survive an isolated controller restart.
value: Worktree Switcher remains an unobtrusive helper and prevents concurrent agents or projects from exhausting the development machine.
